AI Overview
You can play the daily price-guessing game at the official Costcodle website. 
COSTCODLE
How to Play
Objective: Guess the retail price of a mystery Costco product in 6 tries or fewer. 
Winning Condition: Your final guess must fall within 5% of the actual price. 
COSTCODLE
Feedback: After each guess, the game tells you if your price is too high (downarrow) or too low (uparrow). It also indicates when you are within 25% of the target.
